# Data, Reports and Printing

Import and export data, run reports, build dashboards and print documents.

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Data Import and Export](data-import-export.md) | Insert or update many records from CSV, Excel or Google Sheets with Data Import, map columns, read the import log, and export records with Data Export. |
| [Reports](reports.md) | Build and save Report Builder reports, run Query and Script Reports, use prepared and snapshot reports for slow reports, and export results to Excel or CSV. |
| [Dashboards](dashboards.md) | Show counts and charts with Number Card and Dashboard Chart, group them in a Dashboard, and add them to workspaces. |
| [Printing](printing.md) | Print documents, download PDFs made with wkhtmltopdf, and design Print Formats with the Print Format Builder, Jinja HTML or raw commands, plus Letter Head and Print Settings. |
